associationAttendance.title: Event attendance
associationAttendance.lead: Show your QR ticket to an organizer to have your arrival recorded.
associationAttendance.demo: Demonstration: these tickets and attendance records are fictitious and stay in this browser.
associationAttendance.closed: The ticket-reading and check-in window is not open.
associationAttendance.ticketPrivacy: Request your ticket when you arrive. Its code is confidential and can be copied: show it only to the organizer welcoming you. It expires within 15 minutes; renewing it invalidates the previous ticket.
associationAttendance.copied: Code copied. Share it only with the organizer welcoming you.
associationAttendance.copyFailed: Copying is unavailable. Show the code to enter and present it to the organizer.
associationAttendance.cameraHint: The camera starts only when you choose. No image is saved or sent. Native QR reading depends on the browser; code entry remains available.
associationAttendance.videoLabel: Local camera reading of the ticket
associationAttendance.cameraUnavailable: Camera QR reading is unavailable in this browser. Enter or paste the code below.
associationAttendance.cameraDenied: Camera access was not allowed. You can enter or paste the code below.
associationAttendance.cameraFailed: The camera could not read the ticket. Enter or paste the code below.
associationAttendance.scanned: Code read. Preview the ticket before confirming attendance.
associationAttendance.codeHint: Enter or paste only the confidential ticket code. No link or other QR is opened.
associationAttendance.previewHint: Reading the ticket has not recorded attendance. Confirm after welcoming this person.
associationAttendance.countHint: This check-in list is restricted to the event organizers.
associationAttendance.correctHint: This check-in will be removed and its ticket invalidated. Event registration is kept. Check the person and time before confirming.
associationAttendance.corrected: Check-in corrected. Event registration is kept.

errors.association_event_attendance_closed: The ticket-reading and check-in window is closed for this event.
errors.association_event_attendance_code_invali: This ticket code is invalid or expired. Ask the participant for a new ticket.
errors.association_event_attendance_changed: This ticket or check-in changed. Read its current state before confirming.
